system_level.note: descriptive only; systems are few and labelled on different sentence sets for peers vs Logic-LM

planted.note: pipeline check only; never reported as validation

rewrite_invariance.note: z3-equivalent families (REORDER, DEMORGAN, PRENEX, CONTRAPOSITIVE) are invariant BY CONSTRUCTION of eqmv; RENAME (WordNet synonym heads + hashed constants) is the real test of the aligner

score_definitions.c_score: 1 - eq_frac over the full leave-one-system-out LLM pool (candidate C, PRIMARY)
score_definitions.medoid_depth: typed-repair distance to the pool medoid, 0-3 (candidate C)
score_definitions.cluster_entropy: semantic entropy of z3-eqmv classes of pool ∪ {c} (candidate C variant)
score_definitions.c_score_peers6: 1 - eq_frac over the six fresh peers only
score_definitions.c_score_nonoai: 1 - eq_frac over the five non-OpenAI peers
score_definitions.c_score_llm2: 1 - eq_frac over the other Logic-LM systems only
score_definitions.sc5_cheap: 1 - share of K=5 gpt-4.1-nano T=0.7 samples eqmv to c (single-other-model agreement baseline)
score_definitions.sc5_entropy_cheap: semantic entropy of c + the 5 gpt-4.1-nano samples
score_definitions.sc5_same: 1 - share of K=5 gpt-3.5-turbo T=0.7 samples eqmv to c (true same-model SC; gpt-3.5 candidates)
score_definitions.predset_instab_sc: 1 - mean Jaccard of predicate names, c vs SC samples (user's rerun predicate-set similarity baseline)
score_definitions.predset_instab_pool: 1 - mean Jaccard of predicate names, c vs pool members (string-level consensus baseline)
score_definitions.fol_length: number of atoms in the candidate (trivial complexity baseline)
score_definitions.misalign: 1 - alignable_frac (candidate predicates alignable to the REFERENCE; uses gold, confound probe only)
